name: smwmusic-phoenix-wright-ace-attorney-cornered
title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Cornered 52 ~ Pursuit ~ Corner the Culprit (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Pursuit ~ Cornered from Action 52 Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney for Summer C3 2021. Got into the series a few months back and actually started this remix around that time, but never got to finish it... until now.

Absolutely iconic theme song and, for sure, my favorite song in the series, despite it having so many stellar themes that I'm bound to arrange in the future.

versions.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Cornered 52 ~ Pursuit ~ Corner the Culprit (Remix)
